# Deepgram

> Enterprise Voice AI platform providing Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, and Voice Agent APIs with real-time processing, sentiment analysis, and industry-specific solutions.

Deepgram offers a comprehensive suite of voice AI APIs powered by advanced models like Flux, Nova-3, and Aura-2. The platform serves enterprises, startups, and developers across contact centers, medical transcription, podcast analytics, and conversational AI applications.

## Key Topics

- Speech-to-Text (STT)
- Text-to-Speech (TTS)
- Voice Agent API
- Audio Intelligence
- Real-time Processing
- Conversational AI
- Flux Model
- Nova-3 Model
- Aura-2 TTS
- Enterprise Solutions
- HIPAA Compliance
- Sentiment Analysis
- Self-hosted Deployment
- Low-latency APIs
- Speech Analytics

## Core Products & APIs

- [Speech-to-Text API](https://deepgram.com/product/speech-to-text): Real-time and conversational speech-to-text with Flux and Nova-3 models for enterprise transcription
- [Text-to-Speech API](https://deepgram.com/product/text-to-speech): Enterprise TTS with Aura-2 for real-time voice agents and conversational applications
- [Voice Agent API](https://deepgram.com/product/voice-agent-api): End-to-end voice agent orchestration combining STT, TTS, and LLM integration
- [Audio Intelligence](https://deepgram.com/product/audio-intelligence): NLU capabilities for sentiment analysis, intent detection, and speech analytics

## Enterprise Solutions

- [Enterprise Voice AI](https://deepgram.com/enterprise): Self-hosted and cloud deployment options for enterprise-scale voice AI
- [Contact Center Solutions](https://deepgram.com/solutions/contact-centers): Voice AI for contact centers with call analytics and agent assist capabilities
- [Speech Analytics](https://deepgram.com/solutions/speech-analytics): AI-powered call analytics with STT and NLU for quality assurance
- [Medical Transcription](https://deepgram.com/solutions/medical-transcription): HIPAA-compliant medical transcription API with specialized Nova-3 Medical model

## Use Cases & Applications

- [Voice Agents & Voicebots](https://deepgram.com/deepgram-for-voicebots-and-chatbots): Real-time voice AI for conversational agents and voicebot applications
- [Podcast Transcription](https://deepgram.com/deepgram-for-podcast-transcription): Podcast transcription with diarization and voice analytics features
